hitamInternships.title: Automated Aircraft Hangar Towing System
hitamInternships.subtitle: Sensor-Assisted Robotics Prototype
points: Objective: A robotic system that guides a landed aircraft from a staging area into a hangar, built as a scaled prototype.
Core tech: Computer vision, AI object detection, OpenCV, cameras, LiDAR or proximity sensors, and embedded motor control.
Navigation & safety: Route planning, obstacle detection and avoidance, precision navigation and emergency stop.
Build: Functional prototype, hardware–software integration, and a monitoring dashboard.
Outcome: A working demo that improves precision, consistency and safety while reducing manual manoeuvring.
